title: Twinned with Europe, voted Remain? Town twinning and the Brexit vote
excerpt: British towns have 1,445 recorded twinnings, 79% of them with towns in the EU. I checked whether the places with European twins voted Remain in 2016. Comparing like with like, they voted about the same as similar places.
seo_description: 1,445 British town twinnings mapped against the 2016 Leave vote. Did places twinned with Europe vote Remain? Comparing like with like, no clear difference.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Twinned with Europe, voted Remain?' beside a map of Great Britain with blue dots for places twinned with EU towns over constituencies shaded grey by Leave vote, and the lines 1,445 twinnings of British towns, 1,148 with EU towns; comparing like with like, -0.3 points of Leave.
